root.claim: Two $n$-bit integers are multiplied exactly by one deterministic fixed-tape Turing machine in $O(n(\lg n)^{1-\kappa})$ time with $\kappa=2^{-182}$.
root.method: Reduce the product to a convolution of short radix-digit polynomials, evaluate it through Gaussian resampling, Bluestein chirps and synthetic polynomial transforms, and speed up the data movement and butterfly arithmetic of those transforms with two procedures built from linear networks with a rank saving, then verify exactness and the total cost.

motivation.text: A scan of $\Theta(n)$ bits at each of $\Theta(\log n)$ transform levels already costs $n\log n$, so savings are needed in both movement and arithmetic.

children.method: Build both procedures from fixed linear networks whose total edge rank is smaller than the wire count times the label dimension, so that a recursion on smaller calls on smaller volumes saves a power of the width.

adds.name: digit width
adds.meaning: The radix exponent $\lceil\log_2 n\rceil$: each digit of the operands has $b$ bits.

adds.name: address map
adds.meaning: The Chinese-remainder isomorphism from the cyclic coefficient index to the product of prime cyclic axes.

adds.name: twist root
adds.meaning: The root of unity $e^{\pi i/r}$ whose powers twist cyclic coefficients into negacyclic ones.

adds.name: prime window
adds.meaning: The relative width of the interval below $t_i$ from which the prime $s_i$ is chosen.

adds.name: stored volume
adds.meaning: The number of stored data bits of the array being processed.

adds.name: axis count
adds.meaning: The number of axes (equal-width address chunks) handled together, growing like a small power of $p$.

adds.name: working precision
adds.meaning: The number of fractional bits of the fixed-point grid, proportional to $\log n$.

adds.name: record length
adds.meaning: The number of complex coefficients of a polynomial record, a power of two.

adds.name: box size
adds.meaning: The number of entries of the padded power-of-two box, with $Tp=\Theta(n)$.

adds.name: source size
adds.meaning: The product of the pairwise coprime prime source lengths, the number of source entries.

adds.name: chunk width
adds.meaning: The number of bits in one address chunk of the transform layout.

adds.name: padded axis length
adds.meaning: The power-of-two length of axis $i$ of the padded box.

adds.name: prime axis length
adds.meaning: The prime source length of axis $i$, slightly below $t_i$.

root.salient: The saving exponent $\kappa=2^{-182}$ is astronomically small yet strictly positive, so the bound is a true power saving over $n\log n$ although it is invisible at any practical size.
